issue.description:
## Scope
Test that pre-feature and feature-enabled binaries correctly handle capability absence/presence and NEEDLESS fallback/atomic paths.

## Tasks
- Write tests for pre-feature binary behavior (no attempt-resolution support)
- Write tests for feature-enabled binary behavior (attempt-resolution supported)
- Test NEEDLESS fallback when feature is absent
- Test atomic attempt-resolution when feature is present
- Verify both binaries can read old and new checkpoint formats
- Add integration tests that exercise both code paths

## Acceptance
- tests/binary_compat.rs covers all compatibility scenarios
- Pre-feature binary correctly detects lack of attempt-resolution support
- Feature-enabled binary correctly enables attempt-resolution
- NEEDLESS fallback path is tested and works
- Atomic attempt-resolution path is tested and works
- Both binaries can read old-format checkpoints without corruption
- Both binaries can read new-format checkpoints correctly
- cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test pass
issue.title: Implement compatibility tests for binary versions
